rationale: The assistant reached the correct fix (high loop in the drain hose), which resolved the problem. It took too long to get there: it started with the filter and blanking plug, and it only confirmed the missing high loop after the customer had raised it twice. It also repeated hose kink and blocked checks and asked about drips and splits after the issue was solved, and it suggested asking a plumber about the blanking plug. There were no unsafe instructions and no unnecessary parts.
